answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 18 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in quartz, queued in walnut, and cedar publishes the wait time. A farm of 193 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3916 identities would post 876 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
